name: luau-target
description: Adds #luau as a compile target: real Roblox Luau output (variables, functions, if/while/for/repeat, lists, print, task.wait) for pasting into a Script/LocalScript. Use '#'/'##' raw-code lines for Instance.new, game:GetService(...), workspace, CFrame/Vector3 and :Connect(...) events - the same escape hatch the #c++ target uses for direct Arduino calls. See the lua-target plugin for the plain-Lua sibling.
